why: Named landforms that make a Solar System world recognisable. Each name attaches to a surfaceKeyAt id the engine already paints, so a square called sputnik is Sputnik Planitia rather than a texture. Positions are IAU planetocentric for a future camera; the match today is the key.

Mercury.name: Caloris
Mercury.why: The giant basin. The antipode is chaotic terrain from the same impact.

Venus.name: Aphrodite Terra
Venus.why: The type tessera highland. Older than the plains, not a continent.

Mars.name: Olympus Mons
Mars.why: The tallest shield. Any high volcano square is this family.

Mars.name: Valles Marineris
Mars.why: The equatorial cut. A world with no names is a texture; this is why Mars is Mars.

Mars.name: Hellas
Mars.why: The deep low. Not a sea.

Luna.name: Mare Imbrium
Luna.why: Flood basalt on the nearside. Dark because it is young iron-rich rock.

Io.name: Loki Patera
Io.why: The type lava lake. The floor is black glass; the rim is sulfur.

Europa.name: Conamara Chaos
Europa.why: Broken, rotated ice. The shell failed; the ocean almost showed.

Enceladus.name: tiger stripes
Enceladus.why: South-polar fissures. This is where the ocean vents into space.

Titan.name: Kraken Mare
Titan.why: The largest methane sea. The hydrological cycle is real; the solvent is not water.

Pluto.name: Sputnik Planitia
Pluto.why: Convecting nitrogen ice in the heart. The cells are the convection, not craters.

Triton.name: cantaloupe terrain
Triton.why: Dimpled ice. Diapirs, not impact saturation.

Mimas.name: Herschel
Mimas.why: The 130 km crater. A moon that looks like a Death Star because of one impact.

Iapetus.name: Cassini Regio
Iapetus.why: The leading face. Dust from Phoebe, kept dark by a thermal runaway.

Charon.name: Mordor Macula
Charon.why: The red polar cap. Methane from Pluto, processed red. Not rust.

Phobos.name: Stickney
Phobos.why: The giant crater. The grooves are the tidal stress that will finish the moon.

Ceres.name: Occator
Ceres.why: Carbonate salts. Brine that reached the surface and froze white.

Ceres.name: Ahuna Mons
Ceres.why: The cryovolcanic dome. Ice volcanism, not silicate.

Jupiter.name: Great Red Spot
Jupiter.why: A long-lived anticyclone. The square is a pressure level, not land.

Saturn.name: north polar hexagon
Saturn.why: A standing wave in the polar jet, not a crater.

Miranda.name: Verona Rupes
Miranda.why: Among the tallest scarps known. Mismatched terrain jammed together.
